xmldoc.short_description: Encode records and write them to a file, a file identifier or a ZIP entry.

syntax.syntax_item: protobuf.write(schema, type, filename, value, 'Delimited', true, 'Append', tf, 'Progress', f)

param_input_item.param_description: a schema from protobuf.load and a message type.
a data file name, an open file identifier written at its position, or a nelson.io.ZipArchive open for writing with 'Entry', name.
the records to write, in any form accepted by protobuf.encode (struct, columns, table, timetable).
logical (default false), with a file name: add the records at the end of the file instead of replacing it.
a function handle f(n, total) called after each 8 MiB block written (bytes written, bytes to write).

description.p: protobuf.write encodes records and writes them in one step to a file, an open file identifier or an entry of a ZIP archive. It takes the same values and options as protobuf.encode, and avoids holding the whole encoded buffer when it is not needed.
'Append' adds records at the end of an existing delimited file. To write records as they arrive, over several calls while the target stays open, use protobuf.Writer.

example_item.example_item_description: Write a stream in two calls, appending the second
